title: a2a team spec
description: A multi-agent a2a team: shared defaults plus a map of named agents launched by `a2a start --team-file`.

version.description: Team spec schema version. Version 2 makes unattended (yolo) mode the default for all agents unless a per-agent or defaults `yolo` overrides it.

name.description: Team name (tmux session name, kill target, bridge description tag). Defaults to the spec filename if omitted.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this team does. Shown in team listings.

dashboard.description: When true, launch the team with the dashboard TUI view.

defaults.description: Values inherited by every agent unless the agent overrides them. `role`/`role_file` here are prepended to each agent's own role.

skill.description: Optional skill hint(s) recorded on the team defaults (informational; not consumed by the launcher).

agents.description: The agents in this team. Map of agent-id -> agent config (preferred), or an array of agent objects each with an `id`.

backend.description: CLI backend that runs this agent.

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent. Relative paths resolve against the launch directory; absolute paths are allowed (e.g. pointing agents at a sibling repo).

role.description: Inline role/system prompt for the agent. Mutually exclusive with `role_file`.

role_file.description: Path (relative to the spec file) to a file whose contents become the agent's role prompt. Mutually exclusive with `role`.

env.description: Environment variables for the agent process. Merged over the team defaults' env.

args.description: Extra CLI arguments appended to the backend invocation.

yolo.description: Unattended mode: run without approval prompts. Explicit true/false always wins over the version-2 default. Resolution order: per-agent -> defaults -> (version >= 2 ? true : false).

agent.description: A single agent. Inherits unset fields from `defaults`.
